derivation_summary: Factor numerator 9x^2+30x+25=(3x+5)^2 (perfect-square trinomial), factor denominator 3x^2+14x+15=(3x+5)(x+3), cancel (3x+5) to get (3x+5)/(x+3), so a=3,b=5,c=3, sum=11.
Expand (2x+7)^2=4x^2+28x+49, recognize (2x-3)(2x+3) as DoS=4x^2-9, subtract with sign distribution: 4x^2+28x+49-4x^2+9=28x+58.
Factor 9x^2-16 as DoS (3x+4)(3x-4), cancel (3x+4) with denominator to get 3x-4.
Distribute 3x(2x+4)=6x^2+12x, subtract 6x to combine: 6x^2+12x-6x=6x^2+6x.
Recognize (4x+11)(4x-11) as DoS pattern: (4x)^2-11^2=16x^2-121.
Divide each term by 6x^2: 18x^5/6x^2=3x^3, -12x^3/6x^2=-2x, 6x^2/6x^2=1. Result: 3x^3-2x+1.
Factor 49x^2-121 as DoS (7x+11)(7x-11), cancel (7x+11) to get 7x-11.
Recognize 9x^4-25y^6=(3x^2)^2-(5y^3)^2 as DoS, factor and cancel (3x^2+5y^3) to get 3x^2-5y^3.
Factor x^2-9 as DoS (x-3)(x+3), factor x^2+7x+12=(x+3)(x+4), cancel (x+3) to get (x-3)/(x+4).
Polynomial long division of 6x^3+11x^2-19x+6 by 2x-1 yields quotient 3x^2+7x-6 with remainder 0.
Partial fractions: 7x+11=A(x+4)+B(x-1). Substituting x=1 gives A=18/5, x=-4 gives B=17/5. A+B=35/5=7.
Common denominator (x+5)(x-2). Cross-multiply: 2x(x-2)+3(x+5)=2x^2-4x+3x+15=2x^2-x+15.
Distribute 3(2x+4)=6x+12, combine with -2x: 6x+12-2x=4x+12.
Factor 6x^2-19x+10 by grouping: find factors of 60 summing to -19 (-4,-15). Rewrite: 2x(3x-2)-5(3x-2)=(2x-5)(3x-2). Cancel (3x-2) to get 2x-5.
Divide monomials: 42/7=6, x^11/x^4=x^(11-4)=x^7. Result: 6x^7.
Distribute 5(3x-4)=15x-20, combine with -2x: 15x-20-2x=13x-20.
Combine like terms: 3x^2-2x^2=x^2, 7x+4x=11x, constant -9 unchanged. Result: x^2+11x-9.
Factor 25x^2-81 as DoS (5x+9)(5x-9), cancel (5x-9) with denominator to get 5x+9.
Distribute negative sign across second polynomial, then combine like terms: 3x^2-x^2=2x^2, -11x-7x=-18x, 4+9=13.
Distribute 4(3x+5)=12x+20 and -2(x-9)=-2x+18, combine like terms: 10x+38.
Factor 6x^2+19x-7 by grouping: find factors of -42 summing to 19 (21,-2), group as 3x(2x+7)-1(2x+7)=(3x-1)(2x+7), cancel (2x+7), a=3 b=-1 product=-3.
FOIL (3x+4)(2x-5)=6x^2-15x+8x-20=6x^2-7x-20, match coefficient of x: b=-7.
Factor both trinomials: (x-6)(x-7)/(x-5)(x-6), cancel (x-6) to get (x-7)/(x-5), rewrite as 1+(-2)/(x-5), so k=-2.
Distribute 4(3x-8)=12x-32 and -2(5x+3)=-10x-6, combine: 2x-38.
Factor numerator (2x-3)(x+5) and denominator (2x-3)(x-1), cancel (2x-3) to get (x+5)/(x-1).
Factor 2x^2+7x+3=(2x+1)(x+3), cancel (2x+1) with denominator to get x+3.
Distribute 7(3x-4)=21x-28, subtract 5x: 16x-28.
Factor 4x^2+20x+21=(2x+3)(2x+7), cancel (2x+3) to get 2x+7.
Multiply monomials: 3*7=21, x^2*x^5=x^7 by adding exponents. Result: 21x^7.
Recognize (x-2)^2 and (x+2)^2, multiply as [(x-2)(x+2)]^2=(x^2-4)^2, expand to x^4-8x^2+16.
Polynomial long division of 7x^2+23x-28 by x+4 yields 7x-5 remainder -8, so a=7,b=-5,c=-8, sum=-6.
Factor 6x^2+19x-7 by grouping: factors of -42 summing to 19 are 21,-2. Group 3x(2x+7)-1(2x+7)=(3x-1)(2x+7).
Common denominator (x+3)(x-1), cross-multiply: 5(x-1)+2(x+3)=7x+1, so a=7,b=1, sum=8.
Factor 8x^3-27 as difference of cubes (2x-3)(4x^2+6x+9), cancel (2x-3) to get 4x^2+6x+9, sum a+b+c=19.
Divide each term by 2x: 4x^3/2x=2x^2, 10x^2/2x=5x, -30x/2x=-15. Sum a+b+c=2+5-15=-8.
Factor numerator (2x+1)(x+3) and denominator (2x+1)(x-3) by grouping, cancel (2x+1) to get (x+3)/(x-3).
Distribute 3(2x-7)=6x-21, add 4x: 10x-21.
Apply difference of squares identity: [(3x+11)+(3x-11)][(3x+11)-(3x-11)]=(6x)(22)=132x.
Distribute 4(3x-5)=12x-20, add 7x: 19x-20.
Factor x^2-9 as difference of squares (x-3)(x+3), cancel (x+3) to get x-3.
Recognize 8x^3-27 as difference of cubes: (2x-3)(4x^2+6x+9), cancel denominator (4x^2+6x+9) to get 2x-3.
Factor numerator (x+3)(x+4) and denominator as DoS (x+3)(x-3), cancel (x+3) to get (x+4)/(x-3), a=4 b=3 sum=7.
Divide each term by 6x^2y^2: 18x^5y^3/6x^2y^2=3x^3y, -12x^2y^4/6x^2y^2=-2y^2. Result: 3x^3y-2y^2.
Factor 9x^2-49 as difference of squares (3x+7)(3x-7), cancel (3x+7) to get 3x-7.
Add exponents for multiplication x^7*x^3=x^10, subtract for division x^10/x^4=x^6.
Simplify 9a^3b^5/(3a^{-1}b^2)=3a^4b^3 using negative exponent rule, multiply by 2b/a^2=6a^4b^4/a^2=6a^2b^4.
Factor x^2-9=(x-3)(x+3) as DoS, x^2+5x+6=(x+2)(x+3) as trinomial, cancel (x+3) to get (x-3)/(x+2).
Factor four polynomials: x^2-121=(x+11)(x-11) DoS, x^2+6x-55=(x+11)(x-5) trinomial, x^2-25=(x+5)(x-5) DoS, x^2-22x+121=(x-11)^2 PST. Cancel (x+11),(x-5),(x-11) to get (x+5)/(x-11).
Combine like terms: 7x^2+4x^2=11x^2, -3x+9x=6x, constant -2. Result: 11x^2+6x-2.
Divide monomial: 45/9=5, m^{6-2}=m^4. Result: 5m^4.
Recognize 27x^3+125=(3x)^3+5^3 as sum of cubes, factor (3x+5)(9x^2-15x+25), cancel (3x+5) to get 9x^2-15x+25, sum=19.
Recognize 27x^6-8=(3x^2)^3-2^3 as difference of cubes, factor (3x^2-2)(9x^4+6x^2+4), cancel (3x^2-2) to get 9x^4+6x^2+4.
Factor: 4x^2-25=(2x-5)(2x+5) DoS, 2x^2+9x+10=(2x+5)(x+2) grouping, x^2+5x+6=(x+2)(x+3) trinomial. Cancel (2x+5),(2x-5),(x+2) to get x+3.
Factor out GCF 7x from 7x^2-21x to get 7x(x-3).
Factor 10x^2+31x-14 by grouping: product -140, sum 31 gives 35,-4. Group: (5x-2)(2x+7), cancel (2x+7) to get 5x-2, a+b=3.
Factor out GCF 3x: 6x^3-15x^2+9x=3x(2x^2-5x+3), then factor trinomial (2x-3)(x-1). Result: 3x(2x-3)(x-1).
Factor 8x^3+27=(2x+3)(4x^2-6x+9) sum of cubes, 4x^2-9=(2x-3)(2x+3) DoS, cancel (2x+3) to get (4x^2-6x+9)/(2x-3), sum=6.
Polynomial long division of 3x^3-13x^2+16x-4 by x-2 yields quotient 3x^2-7x+2, sum a+b+c=-2.
Factor all four trinomials: (x+8)(x-5)/(x-5)(x-8) * (x-8)(x+5)/(x+8)(x+5). Cancel all common factors to get 1.
Factor numerator 4(x^2-4)=4(x-2)(x+2), denominator 2(x+2), cancel (x+2) to get 2(x-2)=2x-4.
Factor 4x^2-25 as DoS (2x+5)(2x-5), cancel (2x+5) to get 2x-5.
Simplify sqrt(50)=5sqrt(2), sqrt(18)=3sqrt(2), combine 8sqrt(2)/sqrt(2)=8, square to get 64.
Factor x^2-9=(x-3)(x+3) as DoS, cancel (x+3) to get x-3.
Factor 25x^2-81=(5x+9)(5x-9) as DoS, cancel (5x-9) to get 5x+9.
Factor out GCF 4x from 8x^2+20x to get 4x(2x+5).
Factor 36x^2-121=(6x+11)(6x-11) as DoS, cancel (6x+11) to get 6x-11.
Divide each term by 4x: 4x^2/4x=x, -16x/4x=-4. Result: x-4.
Distribute negative: 5x^2-13x+4-3x^2-2x+17. Combine: 2x^2-15x+21.
Factor out GCF 7x: 7x^3-21x^2+14x=7x(x^2-3x+2).
Combine fractions in numerator: 7/[(x-2)(x+5)], in denominator: 4/[(x-2)(x+5)], divide to get 7/4.
Apply DoS identity: (3x+2-x+2)(3x+2+x-2)=(2x+4)(4x)=8x(x+2) after factoring out 2.
Distribute 3(x+4)=3x+12, -2(x-1)=-2x+2, combine: x+14.
Distribute negative: 7x^2-3x+4-2x^2-5x+9. Combine: 5x^2-8x+13.
Use identity a^3+b^3=(a+b)^3-3ab(a+b)=125-45=80, substituting a+b=5 and ab=3.
Factor 9a^2-49b^2=(3a+7b)(3a-7b) as DoS, cancel (3a+7b) to get 3a-7b.
Apply DoS identity: (5x-3-5x-3)(5x-3+5x+3)=(-6)(10x)=-60x.
Distribute 4(3x-11)=12x-44, add 7x: 19x-44.
Recognize 25x^2-49y^2=(5x)^2-(7y)^2 as DoS, factor as (5x+7y)(5x-7y).
Divide each term by 3a^2b^2: 9a^4b^3/3a^2b^2=3a^2b, -6a^2b^5/3a^2b^2=-2b^3, 12a^3b^2/3a^2b^2=4a. Result: 3a^2b-2b^3+4a.
Distribute 3(2x^2-7x)=6x^2-21x, add 4x: 6x^2-17x.
Apply DoS identity: (4x+9+4x-9)(4x+9-4x+9)=(8x)(18)=144x.
Combine like terms: 3x^2-2x^2=x^2, 7x+4x=11x, -9 unchanged. Result: x^2+11x-9.
Long division of 2x^3+7x^2-17x+3 by 2x+1 yields x^2+3x-10 remainder 13. b+c+r=3+(-10)+13=6.
Divide each term by 3x: 6x^3/3x=2x^2, 15x^2/3x=5x. Result: 2x^2+5x, c=5.
Factor 9x^2-49=(3x+7)(3x-7) as DoS, cancel (3x+7) to get 3x-7.
Divide monomial: 18/6=3, a^{5-2}=a^3, b^{3-1}=b^2. Result: 3a^3b^2.
Factor 25x^2-121=(5x+11)(5x-11) as DoS, cancel (5x+11) to get 5x-11.
Factor 2x^2+7x-15 by grouping: product -30, sum 7 gives 10,-3. Group: (2x-3)(x+5).
Combine like terms: 7x²+4x²=11x², -3x+11x=8x → 11x²+8x. B adds |coeff|, C subtracts x² terms, D keeps negative sign.
Divide each term by 9x²: 2x³-3x+1. A drops constant (incomplete division), B sign error, D adds exponents instead of subtracting.
Factor x from numerator, factor trinomial 6x²+19x-7=(3x-1)(2x+7), cancel (2x+7) with denominator factor. a=3,b=-1,ab=-3. Distractors reflect sign/factoring errors.
Distribute 9 and -4: 18x-63-12x-20=6x-83. A fails to distribute negative to +5, B adds x-terms, D both errors.
Distribute: 3x+12-2x+2=x+14. B subtracts 2 instead of adding (sign error on -2·-1), C adds x-coefficients, D partial distribution error.
Factor out 3: 3(x²+4x-5)=3(x+5)(x-1). B has wrong signs on factors, C doesn't factor out GCF first, D incorrect factoring.
FOIL: 6x²+27x-14x-63=6x²+13x-63. B negates middle term, C wrong constant sign, D adds all cross terms without combining.
Common denominator (x-5)(x+1)=x²-4x-5. Numerator: 3(x+1)+2(x-5)=5x-7. A distributes wrong, B just adds numerators, D wrong denominator.
Expand (2x+7)²=4x²+28x+49, subtract 4x² → 28x+49. A omits middle term, B partial expansion, D forgets subtraction.
Divide each term by 3a²b²: 3a²b-5b³. B adds exponents in second term, C wrong coefficients, D multiplies exponents.
25x²-121=(5x)²-11²=(5x-11)(5x+11). B squares one factor, C wrong coefficient split, D factors out wrong GCF.
Factor: (x+4)(x+7)/((x+7)(x-7))=(x+4)/(x-7). B cancels wrong factor, C wrong numerator factor, D doesn't cancel properly.
Divide each term by 7x²: 2x²-3x+5. So c=5.
Recognize a²-4a+4=(a-2)², divide by (a-2)→a-2. Substitute a=2x+1: 2x-1. A adds instead of subtracts, C expands fully, D returns a without simplifying.
Distribute 4 and 3: 4x²+20x-8+6x²-3x+18=10x²+17x+10. B adds |x-coefficients|, C sign error on constant, D both.
Divide each term by 5x: x²-4x+3. b=-4,c=3,b+c=-1. B wrong sum, C sign error, D only b.
Expand: (2x+5)²-25=4x²+20x. Factor: 4x(x+5). Divide by 4x: x+5. A sign error, C doesn't divide, D wrong expansion.
Difference of cubes: 8x³-27=(2x-3)(4x²+6x+9). Cancel (2x-3)→4x²+6x+9. B negates middle term, C drops middle term, D squares binomial instead.
Factor: (2x-3)(x+7)/((x-3)(x+3))·(x+3)²/((2x-3)(2x+3)). Cancel (2x-3) and one (x+3): (x+7)(x+3)/((x-3)(2x+3)). B over-cancels, C wrong diff-of-squares factor, D over-cancels.
9x⁴-25y²=(3x²+5y)(3x²-5y). Cancel (3x²+5y)→3x²-5y. A picks wrong factor, C doesn't factor fully, D incomplete cancellation.
Factor: 4(x-3)(x+3)/(2(x+3)(x+4)). Cancel (x+3), reduce 4/2: 2(x-3)/(x+4). B wrong sign, C cancels wrong factor, D not fully reduced.
Factor: (x+4)(x+7)/((x-7)(x+7)). Cancel (x+7): (x+4)/(x-7). B keeps wrong denominator factor, C wrong numerator sign, D doesn't cancel.
Expand (x+3)³=x³+9x²+27x+27, (x-3)³=x³-9x²+27x-27. Subtract: 18x²+54. a=18,b=54,a+b=72.
Factor: (x-3)(x+3)/((x+3)(x+4))·(x+4)²/((x-4)(x+3)). Cancel shared factors: (x-3)(x+4)/((x+3)(x-4)). A over-cancels, C cancels wrong factors, D over-cancels.
Divide each term by 2x: 2x²-9x+4. a+b+c=2-9+4=-3. A wrong computation, C different error, D another.
14/7=2, x^(5-2)=x³ → 2x³. B subtracts coefficients, C adds exponents, D multiplies exponents.
9x⁴-25y⁶=(3x²)²-(5y³)²=(3x²+5y³)(3x²-5y³). Cancel: 3x²-5y³. A picks wrong factor, C/D don't factor correctly.
3(2x-7)+5x=6x-21+5x=11x-21. B doesn't distribute to constant, C omits +5x, D sign error on constant.
Factor: (x+3)(x-3)/((x+3)(x+4))·(x+4)²/((x-3)(x+2)). Cancel: (x+4)/(x+2). A/B/C cancel wrong factors.
Factor: x²+11x+28=(x+4)(x+7). Cancel (x+4): x+7. A/C/D use wrong factor pairs.
25x²-81=(5x)²-9²=(5x-9)(5x+9). A squares one factor, B wrong coefficient distribution, D random factoring.
Distribute: 10x-15+4x+28=14x+13. B subtracts x-terms, C wrong constant, D sign error.
15x²+35x-10-12x²+3x-27=3x²+38x-37. B wrong x² distribution, C wrong x coefficient, D wrong x² term.
Factor: (x-2)(x-7)/((x-2)(x+2)). Cancel (x-2): (x-7)/(x+2). Original undefined at x=2 (and x=-2). Answer: 2.

Long division: 10x³-23x²+13x-2 ÷ (2x-1) = 5x²-9x+2. a+b+c=5-9+2=-2.
6x²-21x+12-x²-5x+9=5x²-26x+21. B misses distributing negative to -5x, C sign error on constant, D wrong x² coefficient.

Factor: (x-2)(x+2)/((x+2)(x+3)). Cancel (x+2): (x-2)/(x+3). A cancels wrong factor, C doesn't fully simplify, D wrong denominator.
Perfect square: (3x+b)²=9x²+6bx+b². Match 6b=42→b=7. c=49.
Factor: 6x(x-3)(x+3)/(3x(x-3)). Cancel 3x and (x-3): 2(x+3)=2x+6. A cancels wrong way, C wrong factors, D doesn't cancel.
3(2x-7)+4x=6x-21+4x=10x-21. B doesn't distribute to constant, C omits +4x, D sign error.
Factor: 5x²+23x+12=(5x+3)(x+4). Cancel (5x+3): x+4. k=4. A/C/D wrong factoring.

Factor: 3x²+17x-28=(x+7)(3x-4). Cancel (x+7): 3x-4. a=3,b=-4,a-b=7. B/C/D wrong factoring.
7(2x+9)-3x=14x+63-3x=11x+63. B doesn't distribute to 9, C omits -3x, D sign error.

Factor: (x+9)(x+4)/((x-4)(x+4)). Cancel (x+4): (x+9)/(x-4). A wrong factor pair, B cancels wrong, D doesn't cancel.
